name: md-lang-id-preserved
body:
The structural scanner emits the existing `md` language id for Markdown, so every non-root Markdown FQN is unchanged: the heading Structs (`md.AGENTS.md.<heading-path>`, `md.README.md.<heading-path>`, `md.opencode-suite/agents/*.md.<heading-path>`) and the non-root dir modules (`md.opencode-suite/agents`, `md.plans`). This is a packaging consolidation (the Markdown frontend's code is absorbed into the bundled scanner), not a graph-identity break; emitting a new id (e.g. a `text` root) would move every Markdown FQN for no benefit.

One FQN deliberately moves: the repo-root module. The pre-change root module is `md.apg` — the basename of the checkout directory (`src/mdlib/src/main.rs`'s `walk`/`build_doc` set the module identity to the file's absolute parent dir, and `rust.apg.ingest.repo_relative_identity` falls back to `file_name(base)` when the dir equals the base). That is a checkout-named module, contradicting `requirements.requirement.portable-graph-identity`, `requirements.requirement.frontend-rooting-from-repo-base`, `requirements.constraint.no-checkout-named-module` and `domain.value.module-identity`. Per SPEC.md §4.3's `<repo-relative-dir>` rule the root module must render repo-relative as `md.` (the same reading as the brief's `toml.` example). So the root module node moves `md.apg` → `md.`. Heading Structs of root files keep their file-rooted form (`md.AGENTS.md.*`), which does not embed the module identity.

Acceptance: a post-change scan of this repo produces the same non-root `md.*` module FQN set (`md.opencode-suite/agents`, `md.plans`) and the same heading Struct FQN set (`md.AGENTS.md.*`, `md.README.md.*`, `md.opencode-suite/agents/*.md.*`) as the pre-change scan, and the repo-root module renders as `md.` rather than the checkout basename `md.apg`; the Markdown heading Structs still resolve.
